title: Los frijoles
goal: Buy beans and be told how to cook them
culture: Red beans, not black — black is Guatemala and Costa Rica, and gallo pinto is made with rojos. Ask how to cook them and you get the whole recipe twice over, which is included in the price and is worth more than the beans.

ok: una libra de frijoles por favor
beats.good: Out of the sack, into the scale, weighed in front of you. Nothing here comes in a packet.
Red. Black beans are Guatemala and Costa Rica; a Nicaraguan kitchen runs on rojos and so does gallo pinto.

beats.es: Ahí le van, fresquitos, de Nueva Guinea.
beats.en: And how do I cook them?
beats.good: Ask, and you get the recipe, then the recipe again, then the answer to a question you did not ask. All of it is free and most of it is right.

beats.es: Los deja en agua desde anoche. Y les echa cebolla, chiltoma, ajo...
beats.good: Con todo is the lot — onion, chiltoma, garlic. Chiltoma, not pimiento: the pepper has a different name here and this is where you learn it.
